summary: Selling has picked up through the morning, pushing benchmarks to their weakest levels of the morning, while pockets of stock-specific buying keep the broader market from capitulating.

detail.leaders: Jewellery stocks (Senco Gold, PC Jeweller) on Q2 updates
detail.tone: Weaker than the 10 am note: the latest live headline has Sensex down about 400 pts and Nifty around 22,450, versus 22,543 in early trade.
